protocol_name: Three-lineage differentiation, interaction and barcoded collection (valve-free chip)

sizing.capsule_count_note: not in chip spec; sheet default 100,000 used

events.narration: Mode 2 (separate growth): Coat n_cx through p_in alone with coating solution; the other inlets stay capped so the neural chamber is the only one wetted. FILL: 1.0 chamber volume(s) to put the reagent in, not a sweep to get the old liquid out; about 37% of what was there stays behind.
Idle (all ports capped): hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Each lane is incubating on its own; the chip acts on one chamber at a time.

Mode 2 (separate growth): Seed iPSCs into the neural chamber through p_in on its own day, with p_mid vented. The other two chambers are untouched, which is why the shared-inlet seed (mode 1) is not used for a staggered schedule.
Idle (all ports capped): All ports capped for 24 hours while the neural cells attach.
Idle (all ports capped): hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Each lane is incubating on its own; the chip acts on one chamber at a time.

Mode 2 (separate growth): Day 1 of the neural lane: half change of neural_induction_medium through p_in, p_mid vented. The three media converge at the junction j_mid, outside every chamber, and leave through p_mid. PARTIAL change: 0.5 of a chamber volume. This is NOT trying to clear the chamber - the conditioned medium left behind is wanted, as in any bench half-change.
Idle (all ports capped): hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Each lane is incubating on its own; the chip acts on one chamber at a time.

Mode 2 (separate growth): Day 13 of the neural lane: change into neural_maturation_medium through p_in, p_mid vented. This one IS meant to clear the chamber - the previous medium drives a different stage and carrying it over would blur the switch - so it sweeps rather than half-changes. The stream meets the others only at the junction j_mid, outside every chamber. SWEEP: 4.6 chamber volumes in total, which is what the 99% exchange goal needs in a well-mixed chamber (what is left after V chamber volumes is exp(-V), so half a volume cannot clear it however often it is repeated).
Idle (all ports capped): hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Each lane is incubating on its own; the chip acts on one chamber at a time.

Idle (all ports capped): Cool the whole chip to 4 C. Cold handling limits activation and stops the lipid-anchored barcodes swapping between cells.

Mode 2 (separate growth): Feed barcode_1 into n_cx through p_in, p_mid vented. A lipid-anchored oligo inserts into the membrane with no antibody and no spin, so each chamber carries its own label before anything is mixed. The leftover medium is the same share in all three chambers, so it does not bias which lane is which. FILL: 1.0 chamber volume(s) to put the reagent in, not a sweep to get the old liquid out; about 37% of what was there stays behind.

Mode 2 (separate growth): Wash unbound barcode out of n_cx through p_in. Carryover causes background, so this decides whether the labels can be told apart, and it is the one step here that MUST reach its exchange goal. SWEEP: 4.6 chamber volumes in total, which is what the 99% exchange goal needs in a well-mixed chamber (what is left after V chamber volumes is exp(-V), so half a volume cannot clear it however often it is repeated).

Mode 2 (separate growth): Lift the cells in n_cx with a gentle, enzyme-free reagent at 4 C. The wash before this left wash buffer, not medium, in the chamber, so one volume of reagent is enough to act. Mode 2 (separate growth): Quench with a carrier-protein buffer through p_in, so released cells do not stick to the walls, and sweep them on to the junction. Recovery is the whole point here, so this is sized to clear the chamber, not to top it up. SWEEP: 4.6 chamber volumes in total, which is what the 99% exchange goal needs in a well-mixed chamber (what is left after V chamber volumes is exp(-V), so half a volume cannot clear it however often it is repeated).

Collect (back-flush): Back-flush g_cx from p_g_out with quench buffer, which lifts the cells off its weir and sweeps them into the junction j_mid. Sized to clear the chamber: cells left behind are cells lost. SWEEP: 4.6 chamber volumes in total, which is what the 99% exchange goal needs in a well-mixed chamber (what is left after V chamber volumes is exp(-V), so half a volume cannot clear it however often it is repeated).

Collect (back-flush): Back-flush a_cx from p_a_out with quench buffer, which lifts the cells off its weir and sweeps them into the junction j_mid. Sized to clear the chamber: cells left behind are cells lost. SWEEP: 4.6 chamber volumes in total, which is what the 99% exchange goal needs in a well-mixed chamber (what is left after V chamber volumes is exp(-V), so half a volume cannot clear it however often it is repeated).

Collect (back-flush): Pool all three barcoded lanes in the junction j_mid. They are safe to mix now because each carries its own barcode: lane identity survives in the sequencing data, and so does any cell that crossed between chambers.
Collect (back-flush): Deliver one counted, barcoded suspension to the outlet for encapsulation.
